supporting_quotes.exact: A B-Tree is a specialized m-way tree designed to optimize data access, especially on disk-based storage systems.
In a B-Tree of order m, each node can have up to m children and m-1 keys, allowing it to efficiently manage large datasets.
The value of m is decided based on disk block and key sizes.

observations.subject: B-Tree
observations.object: a specialized m-way tree designed to optimize data access, especially on disk-based storage systems

observations.subject: B-Tree of order m
observations.object: m children and m-1 keys per node

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-66214b606544[0,110) 原文为“A B-Tree is a specialized m-way tree designed to optimize data access, especially on disk-based storage systems.”，与 claim 的“特化的 m 路搜索树、为优化数据访问而设计、面向磁盘存储系统”逐字对应；evidence-8ae77e263dd5[0,123) 支持“m 阶节点最多 m 个孩子、m-1 个键”；evidence-9816f0e07ebc[0,60) 支持“m 的取值由磁盘块大小与键大小决定”。三者内容一致、无相互冲突；均来自同一来源 web-computer-science-b-tree，属同源引证，未构成独立佐证，但不影响其分别验证 claim 各子句。判定：supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: One of the standout features of a B-Tree is its ability to store a significant number of keys within a single node, including large key values.
It significantly reduces the tree’s height, hence reducing costly disk operations.

observations.subject: B-Tree
observations.object: a significant number of keys within a single node, including large key values

observations.subject: this node-capacity property
observations.object: tree height, hence reducing costly disk operations

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-b1b915105f64[0,143) 支持“单个节点能存大量键（包括大键值）”；evidence-d8f1cb6c82c0[0,82) 中“It”指代上一句所描述的节点大容量特性，支持“显著降低树高，从而减少代价高昂的磁盘操作”。claim 复述的因果链条与源文叙述一致（大键容量→降树高→减磁盘操作），两句引文为同一来源同一主题的两条属性描述，相互印证无矛盾。判定：supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: - All leaf nodes of a B tree are at the same level, i.e. they have the same depth (height of the tree).
- The keys of each node of a B tree (in case of multiple keys), should be stored in the ascending order.
- In a B tree , all non-leaf nodes (except root node) should have at leastm/2 children.
- All nodes (except root node) should have at least m/2 - 1 keys.
A non-leaf node with n-1 key values should have n non NULL children.

claims.rationale: 五条引文与 claim 五条性质一一对应：evidence-76dc09ac3b6d[0,103) 支持“所有叶节点同层同深度”；evidence-64ae9b2b952f[0,104) 支持“键按升序存储”；evidence-929c66dfcdfe[0,87) 支持“非叶节点（除根）至少 m/2 个孩子”（源文“at leastm/2”为拼写缺失空格，语义无歧义）；evidence-00006726c56b[0,65) 支持“除根至少 m/2-1 个键”；evidence-c030dbd0c441[0,68) 支持“n-1 键的非叶节点有 n 个非空孩子”。引文间逻辑自洽（m/2 孩子与 m/2-1 键对应节点上下界），无冲突。判定：supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: While M-way trees can be either balanced or skewed, B-Trees are always self-balanced.

observations.subject: M-way trees vs B-Trees
observations.object: balancing: M-way can be balanced or skewed, B-Trees are always self-balanced

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-a2c2600534ba[0,85) 原文“While M-way trees can be either balanced or skewed, B-Trees are always self-balanced.”与 claim“M 路树可能平衡也可能倾斜，而 B 树总是自平衡的”逐字对应，无条件简或改写。单引文即完整支撑。判定：supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: Search is similar to the search in Binary Search Tree.
Start from the root and recursively traverse down.

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-c36ad82f4456[0,54) 支持“查找与二叉搜索树类似”；evidence-6c2e5c8c86d0[0,50) 支持“从根开始递归向下遍历”，为源文中查找步骤的描述。两条引文共同完整支撑 claim 的两个分句，内容一致无冲突。判定：supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: It is used in large databases to access data stored on the disk
With the indexing feature, multilevel indexing can be achieved.
Most of the servers also use the B-tree approach.
B-Trees are used in CAD systems to organize and search geometric data.

observations.subject: B-Tree
observations.object: large databases to access data stored on disk

observations.subject: B-Trees
observations.object: CAD systems to organize and search geometric data

claims.rationale: 四条引文分别对应 claim 的四个应用场景子句：evidence-8214458f5d1a[0,63) 支持“大型数据库访问磁盘数据”；evidence-2759f2b8a2fa[0,63) 支持“索引特性实现多级索引”；evidence-b73b4224b61e[0,49) 支持“多数服务器采用 B 树方案”；evidence-1c09cbbe9339[0,70) 支持“CAD 系统组织和检索几何数据”。各引文为同一来源列举的不同应用场景，互不冲突。判定：supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: B-Trees have a guaranteed time complexity of O(log n) for basic operations like insertion, deletion, and searching, which makes them suitable for large data sets and real-time applications.
B-Trees are self-balancing.
High-concurrency and high-throughput.
Efficient storage utilization.

observations.subject: B-Trees
observations.object: O(log n) time complexity for insertion, deletion, searching; suitable for large data sets and real-time applications

claims.rationale: 四条引文逐一对应 claim 的四个优势子句：evidence-5363f1317e57[0,189) 支持“O(log n) 保证时间复杂度、适合大数据集与实时应用”；evidence-106c338287c4[0,25) 支持“自平衡”；evidence-2f0c8558da51[0,37) 支持“高并发、高吞吐”；evidence-8c0c9f65c122[0,31) 支持“存储利用率高”。均为源文列举的优势条目，无冲突。判定：supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: B-Trees are based on disk-based data structures and can have a high disk usage.
Not the best for all cases.

observations.object: disk-based data structures and can have high disk usage

observations.object: not the best for all cases
